mapper.select: SELECT store_id FROM pet_order WHERE id=#{orderId}

SELECT id FROM pet_order WHERE id > #{afterOrderId} AND order_stage='PENDING_PAYMENT' AND payment_status='INIT' AND verification_status='UNVERIFIED' AND payment_expire_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, reservation_id, store_id, order_stage, payment_status, pay_amount, discount_amount, verification_status, payment_expire_at, cancel_reason, version FROM pet_order WHERE id=#{orderId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id FROM order_status_log WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND dimension='ORDER_STAGE' AND from_status='PENDING_PAYMENT' AND to_status='CANCELED' AND event_type='PAYMENT_TIMEOUT' AND operator_type='SYSTEM' AND request_id=#{requestId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM order_payment_result WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND result_type='LATE' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pet_order SET order_stage='CANCELED', cancel_reason='PAYMENT_TIMEOUT', canceled_at=#{observedNow}, version=version+1, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND version=#{version} AND order_stage='PENDING_PAYMENT' AND payment_status='INIT' AND verification_status='UNVERIFIED' AND cancel_reason IS NULL AND payment_expire_at=#{deadline} AND payment_expire_at<=#{observedNow}
